source_evidence.text: I run product for a nine-person software company.
One of our oldest customers, Northline, wants a reporting workspace that is quite different from what we planned this quarter.
They are not threatening to leave, but their operations lead keeps saying it would make the product usable across the rest of their team.
Meanwhile we have reliability work we have postponed twice, and we told smaller customers that the next release would simplify the core workflow.
I keep moving between “this is how good products learn” and “we are letting the loudest customer set the roadmap.”
